chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ismail ibn Mihran, from Muhammad ibn Mansur al-Khuzai, from Ali ibn Suwayd; and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazee, from his uncle Hamza ibn Bazee, from Ali ibn Suwayd; and al-Hasan ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Nahdi, from Ismail ibn Mihran, from Muhammad ibn Mansur, from Ali ibn Suwayd, who said:

I wrote to Abu al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) while he was in confinement, a letter in which I asked him about his condition and about many issues. The answer was delayed for months, then he answered me with an answer, and this is its copy: In the Name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. Praise be to Allah, the High, the Magnificent.

It is by His Greatness and His Light that the hearts of the believers see, and by His Greatness and His Light that the ignorant are hostile to Him, and by His Greatness and His Light that those in the heavens and those on earth seek the means to Him through different deeds and contradictory religions. So [there are] the successful and the mistaken, the straying and the guided, the hearing and the deaf, the seeing and the blind, all perplexed. So praise be to Allah, whose religion was known and described by Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).

As for what follows, you are a man whom Allah has placed among the Progeny of Muhammad (peace be upon him) in a special station, and He preserved the affection for what He attracted you to from His religion, and what He inspired in you of guidance and made you clear about the affairs of your religion by your preferring them and referring matters to them. You wrote asking me about matters in which I was observing dissimulation (taqiyyah) and concealing them for a while. So when the authority of the tyrants passed and the authority of the One with Great Authority came, by my departure from the condemned world to its stubborn inhabitants against their Creator, I saw fit to explain to you what you asked me about, fearing that confusion might enter the weak of our Shiites due to their ignorance.

So fear Allah, Mighty is His Mention, and single out for this matter its deserving ones, and beware that you do not become a cause of calamity for the Successors or a provoker against them by publicizing what I entrusted you with and revealing what I told you to conceal, and you will not do this, if Allah wills.

Indeed, the first thing I inform you of is that I announce to you my own self in these nights, not anxious, nor regretful, nor doubting of what is to happen from what Allah has decreed and made inevitable. So hold fast to the Handle of the Religion, the Progeny of Muhammad (peace be upon him), and the Firmest Handle, the Successor after the Successor, and submission to them and pleasure with what they say. Do not seek the religion of those who are not from your Shiites, and do not love their religion, for they are the traitors who betrayed Allah and His Messenger and betrayed their trusts. And do you know how they betrayed their trusts? They were entrusted with the Book of Allah, so they distorted it and changed it, and pointed to the rulers among them, so they turned away from them. So Allah made them taste the clothing of hunger and fear for what they used to do.

And you asked about two men who usurped the wealth of a man which he used to spend on the poor, the needy, and the travelers in the way of Allah. When they usurped it, they were not satisfied until they made him carry it unwillingly on his neck to their homes. When they secured it, they took charge of spending it. Do they reach disbelief by that? By my life, they had become hypocrites before that, and returned Allah's words back to Him, and mocked His Messenger (peace be upon him and his family). And they are the two disbelievers, upon them be the curse of Allah, the Angels, and all people. By Allah, nothing of faith entered the heart of either of them since they emerged from their state, and they did not increase except in doubt. They were deceivers, doubting, hypocrites, until the Angels of Punishment took their souls to the place of disgrace in the abode of permanence.

And you asked about those who witnessed that man while his wealth was being usurped and placed on his neck, among them knowing and denying. So those are the people of the first apostasy from this community, and upon them be the curse of Allah, the Angels, and all people.

And you asked about the extent of our knowledge, and it is upon three aspects: the past, the future, and the newly occurring. As for the past, it is explained; as for the future, it is written down; and as for the newly occurring, it is a thrust into the hearts and a pecking in the ears, and it is the best of our knowledge. And there is no Prophet after our Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).

And you asked about the mothers of their children, and about their marriages, and about their divorces. As for the mothers of their children, they are prostitutes until the Day of Resurrection, married without a guardian, and divorced without a waiting period. And as for whoever enters our call, his faith demolishes his misguidance, and his certainty demolishes his doubt.
And you asked about the Zakat among them. So whatever is of the Zakat, you are more deserving of it, because we have made it lawful for you, whoever you are and wherever you are.
And you asked about the weak. So the weak is one who has not had the proof raised to him and did not know the difference. So if he knows the difference, he is not weak.

And you asked about the testimonies for them. So establish the testimony for Allah, Mighty and Majestic, even if it is against yourself, your parents, and your relatives, in what is between you and them. So if you fear injustice against your brother, do not [remain silent], and call to the conditions of Allah, Mighty is His Mention, through our recognition. Whoever you hope will be answered, and do not fortify yourself with the fort of hypocrisy. And befriend the Progeny of Muhammad (peace be upon him), and do not say about what reaches you from us and is attributed to us, 'This is false,' even if you know from us the opposite of it, for you do not know why we said it and upon what aspect we described it. Believe what I inform you of, and do not publicize what I told you to conceal from your news.

Indeed, from the obligatory right of your brother is that you do not conceal from him anything that benefits him in his worldly and afterlife affairs, and do not bear a grudge against him even if he does wrong, and answer his call when he calls you, and do not leave him between him and his enemies from the people even if they are closer to him than you, and visit him in his illness. It is not from the character of the believers: deception, harm, treachery, arrogance, vulgarity, immorality, and commanding for it. So when you see the deformed Bedouin in a large host, wait for your relief and for your believing Shiites. And when the sun sets, raise your gaze to the sky and look at what Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has done with the criminals. So I have explained to you the summary of the generalities. And may Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and his Progeny, the righteous.

key_terms.أَهْلُ الرَّدَّةِ الْأُولَى: The people of the first apostasy
key_terms.الضُّعَفَاءُ: The weak (those lacking knowledge of difference)
key_terms.الْعُرْوَةُ الْوُقَى: The Firmest Handle (referring to the Imam)
key_terms.تَقِيَّةٌ: Dissimulation or concealment of belief due to fear
key_terms.عَوَاهِرُ: Prostitutes (referring to the mothers of the children of the two men)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Musa al-Kadim say about the two men who usurped wealth and the status of their followers?
ai.summary: This epistle, transmitted through multiple chains in *Al-Kafi*, captures Imam Musa al-Kadhim’s (as) transition from *taqiyyah* to broader exposition of doctrine following the decline of the Usawiyyah caliphate. The Imam provides a concise theological framework for Shia eschatology, defining knowledge as past (exegesis), future (recorded), and present (divine inspiration), while offering a definitive verdict on the political usurpers and their followers. It also serves as a practical manual for the community, clarifying rules of testimony, zakat distribution, and the criteria for distinguishing the weak from the knowledgeable in times of religious uncertainty.
